claim: How to download all videos from a TikTok user? - Reddit
summary: I tried this for Tiktok, but it only works up to a point. I managed to rip videos from one channel, but it seemed like too few, so I scrolled all the way to the bottom of their channel to load them all. It only scans and downloads a fraction of them. This is from a channel with probably a few hundred videos in total.
